title: When one fear becomes the climate
subtitle: For the tremor that starts occupying the whole day
description: The shabad answers exile by naming divine kinship as Father, Mother, relative, brother, and shelter. These readings keep fear from becoming the whole atmosphere.

heroSource.shortMeaning: The Lord is named as intimate kin, so fear does not get to decide where you belong.
heroSource.lifeApplication: When a single fear spreads across the day, return to the kinship the shabad gives you.

evidence.coreClaim: This path stops fear from turning into a whole inner climate.
evidence.turn: Anxiety shrinks when belonging to the Divine becomes more real than the fear’s weather system.
evidence.practicalImplication: Repeat one kinship name of the Divine, then answer only the next real need.
